story_title: A Civil Preparedness Workshop in Seoul
paragraphs: A community center in Seoul hosts a civil preparedness workshop about how families can respond to official emergency alerts. The instructor explains that {{mask_1}} receives a warning should stay calm and follow directions from local authorities. Residents are encouraged to rely on {{mask_2}} information officials release, rather than forwarding unverified messages. The instructor reminds participants that {{mask_4}} needs assistance should tell a trusted neighbor or contact local services. Families write down {{mask_5}} contact details they may need and keep the list accessible.

The workshop uses a fictional alert scenario involving a possible missile emergency on the Korean Peninsula. It does not discuss weapons or military operations; instead, participants practice finding official updates and following public safety instructions.
